data.title: A note before the journey
data.goal: Check the departure time, ask about the journey and explain a backup plan.

memoryNodes.cue: What have you prepared before leaving?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 出发前已经准备了什么？
memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 出发准备桌左侧；便签在它右边

memoryNodes.cue: What information must you check, and what duration question can you ask?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 要核对哪项时刻信息，又可以怎样问耗时？
memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 护照夹右侧；门口行李袋在桌前方

memoryNodes.cue: What will you do if your phone does not work?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 如果手机不能用，你会采取什么备用行动？
memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 准备桌前方门口；下一处为车站出口的班车牌

data.situation: On the first morning of her vacation, Maya spread a map across the kitchen table. Her passport was in a blue folder on the left, but the journey still felt vague. She had saved the hostel address in advance. Now she needed the departure time. “The coach leaves at nine,” her brother said, pointing to the ticket. Maya put a yellow time note to the right of the folder. “How long does the journey take?” she asked. “Approximately two hours, if the roads are clear.” Her phone battery was nearly empty. Maya did not want to rely on it for every detail, so she copied the address onto the back of the note. Her brother offered to drive her to the stop, but she could also walk. They agreed to allow extra time. At the door, she checked the folder beside her bag. The note did not promise a perfect journey; it gave her a next step if the screen went dark.
data.zhSupport: 护照夹 → 时刻便签 → 门口行李袋。先确认何时出发，再问耗时，最后说出手机不能用时的备用行动。
data.easySummary: Maya checks when her coach leaves. She asks how long the trip takes and keeps the address on paper.
data.easySummaryZh: 玛雅核对长途汽车的出发时间，询问旅程多久，并把地址写在纸上。

glossary.note: 名词，指交通服务离开的时间或行为。
在某件事发生之前；本课指预先保存旅行信息。
副词，说明数值接近估计值，不承诺精确到达。
旅行身份证件；课文人物把它放好，不暗示所有国内旅程均需护照。
依靠某人或事物完成事情；这里指依赖手机获得信息。
休假或度假时段；本课是人物在假期中的短途行程，不加入 vocation 的职业义。
查清所乘服务何时离开；不是仅查看预计到达时间。

glossary.text: How long does the journey take?
glossary.note: 用 how long 问时长；回答可用 takes + 时长。
为步行、排队或变化留出时间；所需时长随真实行程而变。

glossary.text: If my phone stops working, I can …
glossary.zh: 如果手机不能用了，我可以……
glossary.note: 提出备用行动；省略号部分需要换成实际可执行的方法。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You are leaving tomorrow. Ask your brother to check when your coach leaves.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你明天出门。请哥哥帮你核对所乘车辆的出发时间。
acceptableAnswers: Could you check the departure time for my coach?
Please check what time my coach leaves.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask when your own service leaves. A leaving time is different from a journey length.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 询问自己所乘车辆何时离开；出发时刻和旅程时长是两项信息。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You know the leaving time, but not the length of the trip. Ask for that missing information.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你知道几点出发，但不知道整段旅程耗时。询问这个缺失信息。
acceptableAnswers: How long does the journey take?
How long will the trip take?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask about duration. A clock time alone does not answer this question.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 问的是一段时长；只报几点钟无法回答这个问题。
checks: 不把到达时刻当作时长

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your phone battery may run out. Explain what you have already prepared and what you can use instead.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 手机可能没电。说明你已提前准备什么，以及手机不能用时可以用什么。
acceptableAnswers: I saved the address in advance. If my phone stops working, I can use the address on paper.
I copied the address in advance, so I can use my note if my phone stops working.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the preparation and the backup action. You can describe the same plan in your own words.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 同时说出预先准备和备用行动，允许用自己的话表达相同方案。
checks: 备用方法能脱离手机执行

transferPrompt.function: Give a visiting friend a plan
transferPrompt.cue: A visiting friend is travelling to your town by train. Their phone does not work. Tell them what to check before leaving and how to keep the destination address.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 来访朋友要坐火车到你所在的小镇，手机不能用了。告诉对方出发前要核对什么，并说明如何保留目的地地址。
acceptableAnswers: Check the departure time and write the address on paper in advance. You can use the note when you arrive.
Before you leave, check what time the train leaves. Copy the address in advance so you do not need your phone.
transferPrompt.feedback: You are helping another traveller on a train journey. Change the person and the service, and keep the backup useful.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 现在是帮助另一位坐火车的旅客；换人物和交通服务，仍给出实际可用的备用方案。
checks: 包含出发信息和纸质地址
